# Template asset provenance

This directory contains blank form assets retained as package examples and as
canonical inputs for template-guided extraction. The package software license
applies to the `bcapture` code and metadata; it does not purport to relicense
the PDF assets.

## Initial Epi 2024-05-28

- Files: `initial_epi/2024-05-28/blank_interactive.pdf` and
  `initial_epi/2024-05-28/blank_printed.pdf`
- Form: **HPAI Response / Initial Epidemiological (Epi) Interview**, May 28,
  2024
- Issuing agency: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS)
- Public source: [APHIS HPAI resources](https://www.aphis.usda.gov/animal-emergencies/hpai)
  and the [official blank form](https://www.aphis.usda.gov/sites/default/files/initialcontact-epi-report.pdf)
- Local interactive PDF metadata identifies the title as `Initial
  Epidemiological (Epi) Interview` and the author as `Neshelaar, Wilhelm -
  MRP-APHIS`; it has 12 pages and was created May 24, 2024.
- Local SHA-256: interactive
  `08595167a0030187228a639c99bdfa9e3eaa84b99f044c14c71efd93a4edeee6`;
  printed `5da95931817a499533b8a0c2a883cdaddd6c70edeb21dfe9c5cea36bfc8bf3b5`.

The interactive file is treated as an APHIS-sourced canonical AcroForm. The
printed file is a package-generated printed-space derivative of that source,
used for spatial extraction; it is not represented as an APHIS-issued edition.
The project asserts no independent copyright in the mechanical conversion.
